theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (r s ρ : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → r < s → IsOpen ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ) ∧ CompactlyContained ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ) univ ∧ ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), K ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ → {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| ≤ r} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' K ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ
